customer: Hi there, I'm a college student and I'm selling my cargo van to Northwind Auto, which still has a loan on it. Could you tell me how I'll get paid after signing, and whether I should stop my loan payments? Thank you so much!
agent: Thanks for reaching out! Per our article "When and how you get paid," once the paperwork is signed you can choose a bank draft at the store, direct deposit (1 to 3 business days), or a check mailed to your address (5 to 7 business days). Since there's a loan on your van, we send the payoff to your lender within 2 business days, and you receive the amount left over. Please keep making your loan payments until your lender confirms the payoff.
